name: Berwyn
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Berwyn, IL 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Berwyn, IL: Santa's Workshop, Winter Wonderland, North Pole mailboxes, calls from Santa and the City Hall tree lighting.
lede: Berwyn celebrates Christmas through City Hall and its two park districts: a tree lighting where families meet Santa and his sleigh, North Pole mailboxes in the parks, and Santa's Workshop afternoons full of crafts.
celebrates: The season opens with the City of Berwyn's Annual Tree Lighting Ceremony at City Hall on 26th Street, where the mayor invites families to meet Santa and his sleigh and help light the city tree. On Roosevelt Road, 3rd Ward Alderman Richard E. Leja hosts a Holiday Kick Off with a tree lighting at Berwyn Shops. The Berwyn Park District sets out North Pole Mailboxes at the library, schools and parks and throws a Winter Wonderland at Liberty Cultural Center. The North Berwyn Park District adds Letters to Santa, Santa's Workshop, a house decorating contest and phone calls from Santa. The mayor also thanks residents who give to the Berwyn Holiday Fund for neighbors in need.
lastyear: In 2025 the City of Berwyn's Tree Lighting Ceremony was planned for Monday, November 24, from 5:30 to 6:30 pm at Berwyn City Hall, 6700 W. 26th Street. Nine days earlier, Alderman Richard E. Leja invited families to his annual Holiday Kick Off Tree Lighting Ceremony at Berwyn Shops on Saturday, November 15, from 5 to 7 pm. The plan included complimentary hot chocolate and popcorn, pictures with Santa and Mrs. Claus, and sounds of the season from Lincoln Middle School.
facts: Berwyn got its name from a railroad timetable. Developers Charles E. Piper and Wilbur J. Andrews asked the Chicago, Burlington and Quincy Railroad's passenger agent for ideas, paged through his timetables and chose Berwyn, Pennsylvania, a village about 18 miles west of Philadelphia known for fine gardens. The Cicero Town Board approved the name on May 17, 1890, and Berwyn became a city on June 6, 1908. In December 2024 the North Berwyn Park District reported that Santa had phoned more than 45 children at home.
trains: Trains built Berwyn. When the Chicago, Burlington and Quincy refused to add a stop at Oak Park Avenue, Piper and Andrews built the station themselves and the railroad agreed to stop there. Back in the 1870s, residents had already built their own LaVergne Station at Ridgeland and Windsor Avenues. Today Berwyn has three Metra stations on the BNSF line: Harlem Avenue, Berwyn and LaVergne. For a bigger train day, the Illinois Railway Museum in Union includes unlimited train rides, and the Griffin Museum of Science and Industry in Chicago has a 3,500 square foot model railroad.

faq: Where is the Berwyn tree lighting?

The City of Berwyn's Annual Tree Lighting Ceremony happens at City Hall, 6700 W. 26th Street, in late November. The mayor's invitation says families can meet Santa and his sleigh and help light the city tree. A separate Holiday Kick Off with its own tree lighting takes place at Berwyn Shops, 6931 Roosevelt Road, hosted by Alderman Richard E. Leja.
Where can kids mail a letter to Santa in Berwyn?

The Berwyn Park District sets out North Pole Mailboxes at the Berwyn Public Library, Komensky and Piper schools, Liberty Cultural Center and Freedom, Serenity, Proksa, Mraz, Smirz, Sunshine and Hessler parks. The North Berwyn Park District has its own mailbox at 1619 Wesley Avenue. Both ask for a clear return address so Santa can write back.
Can Santa call my child in Berwyn?

Yes. The North Berwyn Park District runs Santa's Calling, a free program where Santa phones children who have been registered ahead of time. Families sign up at the Community Center on Wesley Avenue or by phone. In December 2024 the district reported that Santa called more than 45 children, with messages personalized to their interests and wishes.
Which park district runs which Christmas events in Berwyn?

Berwyn has two. The Berwyn Park District hosts Winter Wonderland at Liberty Cultural Center and the North Pole Mailboxes around town. The North Berwyn Park District, which residents established in 1976, runs Santa's Workshop, Letters to Santa, Santa's Calling and a holiday house decorating contest from its Community Center on Wesley Avenue. Each sets its own resident and nonresident fees.
Which train stations are in Berwyn?

Berwyn has three Metra stations on the BNSF line: Harlem Avenue, Berwyn and LaVergne. The Berwyn station at Oak Park Avenue exists because the town's founders built it themselves after the Chicago, Burlington and Quincy Railroad turned them down, and the railroad then agreed to stop there.
